messages:
Nadia (CS): Heads-up: ClinicWave pilot goes live Wed morning. Theyre running clinician editing flows with lots of tiny revisions. We need a concise customer-facing operations checklist that covers prefill, debounce, streaming UX, cache keys, and clear renewal triggers. Draft below.
Ethan (SRE): Thanks. Ops constraints: limited budget, want interactive feel (<500ms p50), but we should prioritize cost caps over perfect latency on day 0. Any specific traffic shape?
Sam (AE): Expect heavy short bursts during demos (10-20 requests/min per clinician), peak ~50 concurrent sessions. Finance asked for a safety net: auto-notify AE + customer exec at 150% of forecast.
Vikram (ML Eng): Recommend: 1) aggressive prefix caching for system prompts, 2) client-side debounce for typing (250-350ms), 3) streaming enabled but with finalization handshake to avoid duplicate saves.
Nadia (CS): Customer-facing checklist (one page):
- Quick prep: share Top 12 clinician prompts (we will prefill these via prefill API). Include examples and expected response lengths.
- Warmup: reserve 1 GPU warm pool for first 72h; run scripted warmup (50 sessions) before go-live.
- Cache strategy: prefix-cache for system and template prompts. Key = sha256(tenant + template_id + normalized_prefix). Recommended TTL = 10h.
- Streaming UX: open streaming connection, render chunks incrementally, show partial indicator. Require client to call /finalize when user accepts final text.
- Debounce: client should debounce rapid edits to 300ms and coalesce identical backspaces.
- Token and cost guardrails: per-session token cap = 12,000 tokens; daily account cap = $350 (auto-alert). If daily spend > 120% forecast, trigger AE+CS+SRE review.
- Fallbacks & circuit-breakers: auto-switch to quantized model when util > 72% or p95 latency > 900ms for 3m. Reduce batch size by 50% on fallback.
- Telemetry: ensure events: token_count, model_variant, latency_ms, cache_hit (bool), user_action (edit/accept/cancel). Emit per-request route tags.
- Escalation contacts: oncall SRE, EngOps lead, AE. Attach contact block in Confluence runbook.
Ethan (SRE): Ops snippet for automated fallback (for EngOps):
```json
{
  "tenant": "clinicwave",
  "warm_pool": {"reserved_gpus": 1, "duration": "72h"},
  "cache": {"strategy": "prefix", "ttl_seconds": 36000, "key_hash": "sha256(tenant+template)"},
  "guards": {"session_token_cap": 12000, "daily_cost_cap_usd": 350},
  "fallback_rules": [
    {"metric": "util_pct", "op": ">=", "value": 72, "action": "switch:gpt-q4-small"},
    {"metric": "p95_latency_ms", "op": ">", "value": 900, "action": "reduce_batch:0.5"}
  ]
}
```
Vikram (ML Eng): Also add guidance for prefix length: keep prefilled template to <240 tokens to maximize cache hit. For streaming, prefer chunk sizes of ~64 tokens to balance render smoothness and network overhead.
Sam (AE): Renewal-risk play: attach a 7-day usage summary to the AE dashboard (total tokens, avg cost/session, top 5 journeys). If 3-day rolling avg cost/session > target by 30%, AE schedules a cost review with customer and CS.
Nadia (CS): Runbook publishing plan: one-page PDF for customer, Confluence ops doc with full snippets, and an AE email template for cost alerts. Ill draft the templates and tag this thread.
runbooks-bot: Runbook published: /cs-runbooks/clinicwave-interactive-prefill-checklist - https://confluence.internal/clinicwave-prefill-runbook
Ethan (SRE): Ill add kubectl rollback steps and the manual switch commands in the Confluence ops doc.
Nadia (CS): Thanks team. Will finalize and share with ClinicWave PM/AE before handoff call.
